# J118 finite cut plus actual-mass repair: exact recovery

J118_FINITE_C408_G6 and G7 are distinct homogeneous own121/additionalweak000/primitive000 bodies, V136/E204/F70,C408. G6 has P in (323197300070399,323197300070400)/10^15 and no Q. G7 has P in (323197878451911,323197878451912)/10^15 and no Q. The remaining15 arbitrary-H slots under F85 do not imply cancellability. Neither is own110.
